description: Alkahest-permissive schema for current Harmonia manifests: unknown top-level fields are skipped, never fatal, per the estate's growing-schema law -- this is what lets a future field (hotfix, quark, whatever comes next) exist without breaking every existing reader. Per-tool ladder args stay strict (additionalProperties:false in each ladderArgs_* definition) because that check catches real drift against the registered tool contract, a different and still-wanted concern from top-level manifest growth. Compatibility properties retain observed declaration drift.
